name: wordcloudart-chrome-extension
description: WordCloudArt — Chrome extension that turns a page selection or its main article into a word cloud

scripts.check: node --check src/content/extract.js && node --check src/lib/text.js && node --check src/lib/templates.js && node --check src/lib/wordcloud-engine.js && node --check src/sidepanel/app.js && node --check src/background/service-worker.js
scripts.zip: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/wordcloudart-$npm_package_version.zip && zip -r -q dist/wordcloudart-$npm_package_version.zip manifest.json icons src -x '*.DS_Store' && echo dist/wordcloudart-$npm_package_version.zip
